releases.notes:
Adds egg highlighting for Cobbreeding eggs.

## Changes

- **Shiny and high-IV eggs are outlined in any container screen.** Gold for a
  shiny, green for an average IV at or above `eggHighlight.minAverageIv`, which
  defaults to 25. No command, no per-container registration, and no webhook: it
  works as soon as the mod is installed. A vanilla chest, a Sophisticated Storage
  chest of any tier, a shulker box, and your own inventory all behave the same,
  because the outlines are drawn on the container screen itself.
- **A summary line reports the whole container.** `★` counts shiny eggs, `◆`
  counts high-IV eggs, and `↕` counts how many of those are currently scrolled out
  of view, so a 108-slot chest does not have to be scrolled through to see what it
  holds. Your own inventory slots are left out of the counts.
- Outlines are drawn from each slot's live position, so they stay correct while
  scrolling, after the container is sorted, and after an egg is moved by hand.

An egg's species, shininess, and IVs come from its own
`cobbreeding:pokemon_properties` component, which travels with the item stack, so
nothing is installed on the server. Where a server enables Cobbreeding's
`eggEncryptionEnabled` that component holds ciphertext keyed by a server-only file,
and eggs are simply never outlined.

This works only while a container's screen is open — a client is never sent
container contents otherwise, so eggs cannot be watched in the background the way a
pasture's `has_egg` blockstate can.

## Install

Put `cobble-monitor-1.8.3.jar` in your instance `mods` folder. Remove any older
Cobble Monitor or Night Notifier JAR so only one version is installed.

Requires Minecraft 1.21.1, Fabric Loader 0.16.5+, Fabric API, and Java 21.
Cobblemon 1.7.3 is required for Cobblemon features, and Cobbreeding 2.2.2 for
pasture egg monitoring and egg highlighting. Both are optional at runtime.

See the [full changelog](CHANGELOG.md) and the
[user manual](docs/user-manual.en.md).

releases.notes:
Bug-fix release for pasture parent persistence and diagnostics.

## Changes

- **Pasture parents now survive a relog.** The parent species captured from a
  pasture's Cobblemon GUI lived only in memory and were cleared on every world
  change, so a pasture you rarely open — one emptied by a hopper, for example —
  reported an unknown egg species every session. They are now stored in the
  config and restored on load, so opening each pasture once is enough. The other
  two sources cannot cover for this: Cobbreeding never sends egg item stacks to a
  client, and `PokemonPastureBlockEntity` has no client sync at all, so its
  tethered-entry count is always 0 on a server.
- **Fixed a stale GUI association.** `markPastureInteraction` only ever set the
  pending association, never cleared it. A monitored pasture whose GUI then failed
  to open — which Cobblemon does on the `pasture.too_many_nearby` rejection — kept
  its claim for the full timeout, and the next pasture opened inside that window
  had its parents cached under the monitored pasture's coordinates. Now that the
  cache is written to disk, such a wrong association would have survived relogs.
- **Corrected diagnostics that described the code inaccurately.** "pasture
  inventory not synchronized" implied a timing problem, but a client is never sent
  pasture contents at all, so there is no race to wait for. "Egg inventory usable"
  reported a flag that was true whenever no egg was expected, which is most of the
  time. Parents restored from the config are now reported as a persisted cache
  rather than as a packet received this session.
- **Added a dropped-update counter** for pasture GUI updates received with no
  associated GUI — that path was silent, so its frequency could not be judged from
  a log. The session-wide status lines in `/cobble-monitor debug pasture` are now
  grouped under their own heading, so they are no longer read as describing the
  last pasture listed.

## Install

Put `cobble-monitor-1.8.2.jar` in your instance `mods` folder. Remove any older
Cobble Monitor or Night Notifier JAR so only one version is installed.

Existing configs are upgraded in place; no action is needed. Parents are cached
the next time you open each monitored pasture.

Requires Minecraft 1.21.1, Fabric Loader 0.16.5+, Fabric API, and Java 21.
Cobblemon 1.7.3 is required for Cobblemon features, and Cobbreeding 2.2.2 for
pasture egg monitoring. Both are optional at runtime.

See the [full changelog](CHANGELOG.md) and the
[user manual](docs/user-manual.en.md).

releases.notes:
Bug-fix release for pasture parent reporting.

## Changes

- **Fixed pasture parents sharing a species and form being reported as one
  parent.** Parent names were held in a `Set` keyed on display name, so a pasture
  holding two Hisuian Zorua — or two Ditto — collapsed to a single entry. The
  cache itself was always correct; only the reporting was wrong. This affected the
  `Parents` field of the Discord egg embed as well as `/cobble-monitor debug
  pasture`.
- **Clarified pasture diagnostics.** The parent line now states how many entries
  are cached, and the last-packet line is explicitly labelled a raw packet echo
  rather than the cache. The two legitimately differ whenever the pasture changed
  after its GUI was last opened, which made a correct cache look stale.

## Install

Put `cobble-monitor-1.8.1.jar` in your instance `mods` folder. Remove any older
Cobble Monitor or Night Notifier JAR so only one version is installed.

Requires Minecraft 1.21.1, Fabric Loader 0.16.5+, Fabric API, and Java 21.
Cobblemon 1.7.3 is required for Cobblemon features, and Cobbreeding 2.2.2 for
pasture egg monitoring. Both are optional at runtime.

See the [full changelog](CHANGELOG.md) and the
[user manual](docs/user-manual.en.md).

releases.notes:
Client-side Fabric 1.21.1 Cobblemon monitor. This release improves form-specific
sprite thumbnails and adds Poke Snack counts to Snack alerts.

## Changes

- **Pokemon Showdown sprite fallback for form-specific thumbnails.** PokeAPI's
  sprite endpoint is keyed by Pokedex number alone and cannot address a regional
  or alternate form, so those forms previously fell back to a Cobblemon model
  texture. Alolan, Galarian, Hisuian, Paldean, Mega, and Gigantamax forms now
  resolve to a matching Showdown sprite, in normal and shiny variants. PokeAPI
  remains the primary lookup for base forms and the Cobblemon texture remains the
  final fallback for any other form.
- **Remaining Poke Snack count in Snack notifications.** Alerts now report how
  many servings are left on the eaten block, and state explicitly when the last
  Poke Snack has been consumed.
- **Fixed the internal Discord title key leaking into ntfy messages.** Users with
  Discord disabled saw a raw `_discordTitle: ...` line in every Snack and pasture
  egg notification.

## Install

Put `cobble-monitor-1.8.0.jar` in your instance `mods` folder. Remove any older
Cobble Monitor or Night Notifier JAR so only one version is installed.

Requires Minecraft 1.21.1, Fabric Loader 0.16.5+, Fabric API, and Java 21.
Cobblemon 1.7.3 is required for Cobblemon features, and Cobbreeding 2.2.2 for
pasture egg monitoring. Both are optional at runtime.

See the [full changelog](CHANGELOG.md) and the
[user manual](docs/user-manual.en.md).
